title: Request: add option to turn off "NO BLUETOOTH" vibration on Pebble watchfaces (trend face)
symptom: When using the G5 with xDrip and a Pebble 2, the user often gets "NO BLUETOOTH" alerts because the app resets bluetooth when it doesn't get a signal from the G5, which wakes them up multiple times a night.
cause: The 'No Bluetooth' alert is created by the watch face itself, unlike other alerts, so it needs different handling to create an option for it.
fix: Install the 9th Aug Nightly release, then go to Settings -> Smartwatch Settings -> Pebble -> 'Vibrate when no bluetooth' option and uncheck it. Also, toggle the 'Pebble Watch Integration' slider off and on to reinstall the updated watch face.
evidence_quote: After that look in `Settings` -> `Smartwatch Settings` -> `Pebble` -> `Vibrate when no bluetooth` option which can be unchecked.
